c3d730fc1bd00b9c.description: Job SummaryWith the extreme growth rate of our company, teams, and customer base, we are looking for a Data Analyst to help our Business Intelligence team keep up with the needs of the business by providing data and reports to our various functional areas in a timely manner.As part of this team, youll work with your team members, our Data Architect, as well as stakeholders throughout the company to build and maintain new reports and dashboards in PowerBI and Salesforce, providing better access and visibility to our business data. Youll be working within our CRM looking at Sales, Marketing, as well as with our billing data and product usage data.This position requires a consistent work ethic, strong attention to detail, the ability gather requirements, and a customer-centric mindset.Responsibilities Design, Develop, and maintain reports and dashboards within Power BI and Salesforce in a timely manner based on the needs of the business. Build and maintain Power BI data models, including relationships, calculated columns, and measures. Automate data refresh schedules and ensure the reports are up-to-date with the latest information. Work with data sources such as SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and other external APIs to gather, transform, and load data for reporting. Work tickets assigned to you via Jira through our Analytics Sprint planning process. Providing visible progress and closed-loop communication through updates on the tickets. Work with stakeholders to solve through requirements and achieve a clear understanding on requests. Managing and manipulating data and views to meet the needs of the business Working backwards through metrics and reports to understand filters for the purpose of recreating, improving upon and/or consolidating them Help maintain our data dictionary, reporting index, and any other internal documentation used to provide visibility to our reporting stack to our internal teams Provide feedback to our Data and Operations teams on the states of our data and data sources for opportunities to improve data integrity or gain efficiencies in gathering data. Conduct training sessions or provide support to end-users on using Power BI reports effectively. Stay updated on Power BI updates, best practices, and new features to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of reporting processes. Will be working various cloud software including Salesforce, NetSuite, Hubspot and more.Requirements Bachelors degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered. 4+ years of professional experience in analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related data-focused role. Advanced SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL. 2+ years experience using Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse to query, transform, and analyze business data using advanced SQL. 5+ years of experience building, publishing, and maintaining Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, DAX measures, and Power Query transformations. Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including star schemas, relationships, calculated measures, data quality controls, and performance considerations for BI solutions. Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, automation, and data preparation using common libraries such as pandas, NumPy, or similar tools. Experience with modern data warehousing, ETL/ELT concepts, and cloud data platforms or services such as AWS S3, AWS Glue, AWS RDS, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies. Familiarity with analytics engineering practices such as reusable data models, documentation, data lineage, version control, testing, and governed self-service reporting. Ability to gather requirements, define success metrics, translate business questions into analytical approaches, and communicate trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

c3e9308274829541.description:
We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager - 
Location: Chennai
Experience: 6+ years
Employment: Full-time

About the company
We’re hiring for an AI-native cybersecurity company building products that help organizations identify, prioritize, and act on their most critical security risks.

About the role
We are looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Manager to own key product initiatives from customer discovery and ideation through launch and iteration.
You will work closely with engineering, design, go-to-market teams, customers, and executive leadership to define product strategy, build roadmaps, prioritize features, and deliver products that create measurable customer and business impact.
This is an individual contributor role with significant ownership and influence. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, handling ambiguity, making data-driven decisions, and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.
The role also requires strong technical fluency and an understanding of emerging technologies such as GenAI and LLMs, particularly in cybersecurity contexts.

What we’re looking for
• 6+ years of Product Management experience
• Strong B2B SaaS / technology product experience
• Experience owning products/features end-to-end
• Strong product strategy, roadmap & prioritization skills
• Strong technical fluency and experience working with engineering teams
• Data-driven approach to product decisions
• Experience in cybersecurity is a strong plus
• Understanding of GenAI / LLMs
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
• Strong ownership and ability to influence without authority

If you're a Product Manager who thrives on ownership, moves fast, and loves building products at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, we'd love to hear from you.
